subject.title: fix: recover final replies after settled tool-only turns

question: Should settled-tool finalization run for cron and heartbeat executions when the run has an outbound channel delivery target, or should all scheduled triggers remain deliberately excluded?
rationale: The current reviewer evidence identifies real scheduled production failures, but spending an additional model call and changing cron error/backoff behavior is a product and operational policy choice rather than a mechanical correction.

options.title: Use delivery-aware finalization
options.body: Permit one tool-free finalization for scheduled runs only when the terminal path has an outbound delivery target, while retaining exclusions for silent/background work.

options.title: Keep scheduled runs excluded
options.body: Retain the trigger-based exclusion and accept that scheduled channel announcements can remain silent or fail into their existing backoff path.

recommendation.title: Use delivery-aware finalization
recommendation.body: Permit one tool-free finalization for scheduled runs only when the terminal path has an outbound delivery target, while retaining exclusions for silent/background work.
